name: Clutch
summary: B2B services marketplace: submit a free project brief and get matched with verified, best-fit agencies for your project, with no research required.
best_for: businesses that want to skip manual agency research and get matched quickly with vetted, best-fit service providers for a specific project
skip_if: you already have trusted agency relationships, or you'd rather research independently without agencies contacting you
honest_knock: It's free to submit a brief, but be clear on what it is: a lead-generation marketplace, not a neutral directory. Your brief goes straight to agencies who will reach out to pitch you, and providers pay to be visible and matched. It's a fast way to shortlist vetted agencies; just expect the outreach that comes with it.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-02 and again on 2026-10-06, read in their own help centre) Free for buyers. Clutch's help centre describes the Project Brief as the buyer's route in, and the article on sending one states that Clutch recommends up to 9 service providers that best match your project requirements, with no fee named anywhere in that flow. Clutch is a B2B services marketplace — the providers being listed pay for visibility, the buyer does not, and the help centre says plainly that directory listings are sorted by sponsored providers and Clutch rank. A free provider profile covers the listing, client review collection, badges and widgets, contributed content, awards eligibility, up to 3 sharable case studies and a profile on sister-site The Manifest; Sponsorship, Featured Listings and Clutch Verified (previously Clutch+) are the paid upgrades on top.

compare_with.name: G2
compare_with.why: G2 and traditional directories make you scroll and compare yourself; Clutch's brief-matching narrows it to a handful of vetted providers fast: the trade-off is that it's a matching marketplace where you'll field agency outreach

purchase.how: AIBuilder Marketplace does not sell this software. Sign up, start a trial or buy on the vendor's site.
purchase.disclosure: Where purchase.affiliate is true, purchase.handoff_url is our own review page for the product; the vendor button on that page is a marked affiliate link and AIBuilder Marketplace may earn a commission at no extra cost to the buyer. Commission never changes what a record says, and products are not ranked by commission. Where it is false the link is the vendor's plain site. Since schema 1.1 this API does not publish affiliate links.

claims.plan: No plan was bought and no brief was sent; the lists, a profile and the help article were read

exit_test.what: No account was needed; the tool ran without signing in. On 18 November 2026 the session searched Clutch without an account. SEO agencies in the United States with Under $5,000 and $25 - $49 gave 1,106 Companies, and the first page held 14 Featured cards outside the hourly rate filter. UK web development gave 4,545 Companies, 798 after two filters, and the first Featured card sat outside both. The budget filter is a ceiling, not a minimum, the default sort is Sponsored and the page says We may earn a fee for some placements. The help centre says that Sponsorship and Clutch Verified need a 12-month agreement with no early cancellation and that Verified is billed in full upfront, but no price was found. The first result took about 1 minute and 3 filter steps. Nothing was sent or bought. Account and start: no account was used. Our AI assistant ran the test in a tab of our Chrome on clutch.co, with no login (the interface is in English; the cookie banner was answered with Deny). The header shows Sign In and Join; nothing was filled in. The dossier name is Clutch and the review is on OSM (osm/clutch-review.html). The test date is 18 Nov 2026; the start time was not recorded in the notes. There was no earlier session folder for this tool. Search 1, SEO in the United States (clutch.co/seo-firms): the page showed 85,929 Companies and the filters Client Budget, Hourly Rates, Industry, Services and Location. The Client Budget options are a ceiling (Any Price, Under $250,000 and so on down to Under $5,000), and there is NO filter on a minimum project size. We chose Under $5,000, the hourly rate $25 - $49 and the location United States. The result was 1,106 Companies (URL pattern /us/seo-firms?client_budget=5000&hourly_rate=25-49). The first page held 64 cards, 50 with $25 - $49 / hr and 14 outside it ($50 - $99: 5, $100 - $149: 5, $150 - $199: 4). Those 14 sat in 6 Featured blocks (What are Featured Providers?), which ignore the hourly rate filter; the first card was Funnel Boost Media, $1,000+, $50 - $99 / hr, 50 - 249, Serves United States. On the unfiltered list a Featured company outside the United States had shown up earlier. A card shows the name, a score, the number of reviews, Premier Verified or Verified, Clutch Guarantee, the minimum project ($1,000+), the hourly rate, the team size, the place, the share per service, a summary, Reviewed 5 times in the past 6 months and 3 fixed price packages. The sort box says Sponsored by default and the text above the list says We may earn a fee for some placements. Search 2, web development in the United Kingdom (clutch.co/web-developers/uk): 4,545 Companies; with Under $25,000 and $50 - $99 it gave 798 Companies. The first Featured card, CreativeWeb, showed $10,000+ and $100 - $149 / hr, so it sat outside both filters; there were 3 Featured blocks. Profile (the agency Goodspeed): Min. project size $5,000+, Avg. hourly rate $50 - $99 /hr, Rating for cost 4.9 /5, Most Common Project Size $10,000 - $49,999 based on 33 reviews, with the line This summary is based on verified Clutch reviews. The review table has a column Verified and a button Submit a Review; the reviewer names are public (not shown in our screenshots). Billing terms (help.clutch.co, article on sponsorship billing, read on 18 Nov 2026): Both Sponsorship and Clutch Verified require a 12-month annual agreement; Early cancellation is not available during the initial 12-month term.; Verified is Billed for the full 12-month cost upfront in a single payment. No price for Sponsorship or Clutch Verified was found in public; the Pricing & Packages page for agencies was not opened. Cancelling is only possible after the first 12 months, with notice of at least five (5) business days before the renewal. Time to the first result: about 1 minute and 3 filter steps. Not tested: the Project Brief (Get A Quote, which would send a brief to up to 9 agencies; it was not filled in), Get matched, signing in, writing a review, Pay Per Lead, and the Pricing & Packages page for agencies. Cancelling: not applicable, there is no account. Clean up: no account and no test data; the own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The Featured cards ignore the filters, so a buyer who asks for $25 - $49 an hour still sees agencies at $50 - $99 and above at the top. The budget filter is a ceiling (Under $X), so there is no way to ask for a minimum project size. The default sort is Sponsored. No price for the paid placements is published.

exit_test.what: No account was needed; the tool ran without signing in. On 18 November 2026 the session searched Clutch without an account. SEO agencies in the United States with Under $5,000 and $25 - $49 gave 1,106 Companies, and the first page held 14 Featured cards outside the hourly rate filter. UK web development gave 4,545 Companies, 798 after two filters, and the first Featured card sat outside both. The budget filter is a ceiling, not a minimum, the default sort is Sponsored and the page says We may earn a fee for some placements. The help centre says that Sponsorship and Clutch Verified need a 12-month agreement with no early cancellation and that Verified is billed in full upfront, but no price was found. The first result took about 1 minute and 3 filter steps. Nothing was sent or bought. Account and start: no account was used. Our AI assistant ran the test in a tab of our Chrome on clutch.co, with no login (the interface is in English; the cookie banner was answered with Deny). The header shows Sign In and Join; nothing was filled in. The dossier name is Clutch and the review is on OSM (osm/clutch-review.html). The test date is 18 Nov 2026; the start time was not recorded in the notes. There was no earlier session folder for this tool. Search 1, SEO in the United States (clutch.co/seo-firms): the page showed 85,929 Companies and the filters Client Budget, Hourly Rates, Industry, Services and Location. The Client Budget options are a ceiling (Any Price, Under $250,000 and so on down to Under $5,000), and there is NO filter on a minimum project size. We chose Under $5,000, the hourly rate $25 - $49 and the location United States. The result was 1,106 Companies (URL pattern /us/seo-firms?client_budget=5000&hourly_rate=25-49). The first page held 64 cards, 50 with $25 - $49 / hr and 14 outside it ($50 - $99: 5, $100 - $149: 5, $150 - $199: 4). Those 14 sat in 6 Featured blocks (What are Featured Providers?), which ignore the hourly rate filter; the first card was Funnel Boost Media, $1,000+, $50 - $99 / hr, 50 - 249, Serves United States. On the unfiltered list a Featured company outside the United States had shown up earlier. A card shows the name, a score, the number of reviews, Premier Verified or Verified, Clutch Guarantee, the minimum project ($1,000+), the hourly rate, the team size, the place, the share per service, a summary, Reviewed 5 times in the past 6 months and 3 fixed price packages. The sort box says Sponsored by default and the text above the list says We may earn a fee for some placements. Search 2, web development in the United Kingdom (clutch.co/web-developers/uk): 4,545 Companies; with Under $25,000 and $50 - $99 it gave 798 Companies. The first Featured card, CreativeWeb, showed $10,000+ and $100 - $149 / hr, so it sat outside both filters; there were 3 Featured blocks. Profile (the agency Goodspeed): Min. project size $5,000+, Avg. hourly rate $50 - $99 /hr, Rating for cost 4.9 /5, Most Common Project Size $10,000 - $49,999 based on 33 reviews, with the line This summary is based on verified Clutch reviews. The review table has a column Verified and a button Submit a Review; the reviewer names are public (not shown in our screenshots). Billing terms (help.clutch.co, article on sponsorship billing, read on 18 Nov 2026): Both Sponsorship and Clutch Verified require a 12-month annual agreement; Early cancellation is not available during the initial 12-month term.; Verified is Billed for the full 12-month cost upfront in a single payment. No price for Sponsorship or Clutch Verified was found in public; the Pricing & Packages page for agencies was not opened. Cancelling is only possible after the first 12 months, with notice of at least five (5) business days before the renewal. Time to the first result: about 1 minute and 3 filter steps. Not tested: the Project Brief (Get A Quote, which would send a brief to up to 9 agencies; it was not filled in), Get matched, signing in, writing a review, Pay Per Lead, and the Pricing & Packages page for agencies. Cancelling: not applicable, there is no account. Clean up: no account and no test data; the own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The Featured cards ignore the filters, so a buyer who asks for $25 - $49 an hour still sees agencies at $50 - $99 and above at the top. The budget filter is a ceiling (Under $X), so there is no way to ask for a minimum project size. The default sort is Sponsored. No price for the paid placements is published.
